schema.name: ganglior.node-export
schema.doc: PpgDex PPG-derived events → Ganglior bus. t/tMs = floating wall-clock ms (UTC getters). null = unknown, never fabricated.

timing.reason: host ≡ device — residual spread 0.93 ms ≤ 2 ms (one stamp quantum); this host column is not an independent clock; the rate correction did not reach the published rate: the correction rounded out at the 0.01 Hz step the published rate carries — -11 ppm is under the ~74 ppm that step spans at 135 Hz; nothing here sizes the published ppm: the spine measured no sigma-y curve on this axis, so the rate travels without its spread

hostAxis.rateReason: host ≡ device — residual spread 0.93 ms ≤ 2 ms (one stamp quantum); this host column is not an independent clock
hostAxis.inertReason: host ≡ device — residual spread 0.93 ms ≤ 2 ms (one stamp quantum); this host column is not an independent clock

reserved.doc: Awaiting other fleet nodes; null until available.

evidence.envelopeReason: no acquisition envelope joins the PPG path — the capture-host envelope keys on the O2Ring .dat session_id; PpgDex reads the _PPG.txt stream

hr.uncertaintyReason: not estimated — this node carries no uncertainty model for whole-record HRV summaries (the device-PPI cross-check in `validation` is a comparison, not an interval)

evidence.envelopeReason: no acquisition envelope joins the PPG path — the capture-host envelope keys on the O2Ring .dat session_id; PpgDex reads the _PPG.txt stream

rmssd.uncertaintyReason: not estimated — this node carries no uncertainty model for whole-record HRV summaries (the device-PPI cross-check in `validation` is a comparison, not an interval)

ppg.scopeNote: Every cell of this column describes the reference channel this node picked for the analysis, named beside it — not the three-channel consensus and not the whole file.

coverage.reason: no-census: this recording carries no segment census, so the covered share of its envelope is unknown

timing.unit: ppm of the device rate against the host axis

drift.unit: ppm of the night rate against a named reference
drift.reason: no-walk: this node builds no per-window rate walk over the night, so it measures no drift against a §3d reference — the axis rate beside it is the whole-record figure

reference.unit: ms between the mean self interval and the mean device interval
reference.reason: no-reference: no device interval series reached this node, so no second instrument can be held against its own

rail.railUnit: the rail VALUES of the reference channel, in the stream’s own counts — the census beside them counts samples, not values

snr.unit: ratio of in-band to out-of-band power
snr.scale: a power RATIO, not dB — this node never converts it

mains.unit: ratio of mains-band to in-band power
mains.reason: not-measured: this node notches the mains rate out of the waveform and measures no mains-against-in-band ratio

sidecarEffect.how: the companion’s rows merge into the pinned span sets, so both census cells count the writer’s held runs beside this node’s own; the four unchanged facts are computed from the stream or its clocks before any companion is read
sidecarEffect.undeterminedReason: the span sets also reach the beat rejection, so a companion can move the beat population these four read; no four-way run of one recording has measured which of them moves here
sidecarEffect.population: the call graph of this node, read fact by fact: the ECGDex pilot measured ITS own facts over one synthetic recording run four times (2026-11-15), and no run of this node has been diffed before and after its companion yet

acc.scopeNote: This node reads the motion companion to grade the optical beats, so the column carries the population it placed and the rate it read — never a quality score of the motion stream itself.
acc.inputNote: no-input: no motion companion reached this node with this recording

nodeSqi.reason: no-score: this node scores quality through the optical beat series, so it computes none for the motion stream

coverage.unit: % of the placed epochs with a known motion value

epochs.reason: no-input: no motion companion reached this node with this recording

timing.unit: ppm of the device rate against the host axis
timing.reason: no-axis: this node builds no host-disciplined axis for the motion companion, so no device-against-host rate exists for it

drift.unit: ppm of the night rate against a named reference
drift.reason: no-walk: this node builds no per-window rate walk over the night, so it measures no drift against a §3d reference — the axis rate beside it is the whole-record figure

reference.reason: no-reference: no second motion instrument reaches this node, so nothing can be held against this stream

flatline.reason: no-census: the motion companion’s held runs reach this node as the sidecar state in the ledger below, and this node counts no flat share over the samples themselves

rail.reason: no-census: this node runs no rail detection over the motion stream, and no declared full-scale range reaches it

snr.unit: ratio of in-band to out-of-band power
snr.reason: not-measured: this node computes no in-band ratio for the motion stream

mains.unit: ratio of mains-band to in-band power
mains.reason: not-measured: this node notches the mains rate out of the waveform and measures no mains-against-in-band ratio

sidecarEffect.how: the motion companion’s own run census reaches the ledger row below and no cell of this column, so every cell’s before value and after value are one number
sidecarEffect.population: the call graph of this column, read cell by cell: the claim is structural rather than measured, because no cell here reads `accSidecar` and the ledger row below reads it instead

quality.motionRejectedPctReason: no inertial stream was loaded — no beat was examined for motion

time.windowNote: sdnn/rmssd are whole-record (single-site PPG); per-5-min values live in epochs[]. Directly comparable to another node’s wholeRecord SDNN/RMSSD. hr is the DISPLAY rate instead: the 5-min epoch median on a record over 90 min, the whole-record rate below that. hrWindow names which one this export carries, and wholeRecordHR is the cross-node HR axis.
time.sdnnNote: whole-record sdnn runs high on optical — SDANN/baseline-wander inflation the chest ECG does not carry. sdnnIndex (mean of per-5-min SDNN) and sdnnRobust (quality-gated MEDIAN of per-5-min SDNN) both remove it, sdnnRobust the most; use sdnnRobust for cross-node SDNN comparison. Bias magnitudes are deliberately not quoted here: the earlier figures came from a single paired night and did not reproduce on the multi-night corpus.

confidence.note: 0..1 per-metric confidence from measured drivers (motion→hf, posture/baseline→vlf/sdnn, coverage+correction→beat-to-beat). vlf capped 0.7 — single-site optical VLF stays baseline-wander-limited even when clean; not a defect to "fix". A metric is null when its driver was NOT MEASURED (see `evidence`): a session with no accelerometer has no motion-graded hf, and publishing one would be a grade resting on nothing.

apnea.cvhrMethod: CVHR events/h from finger PPI NN (Hayano apnea-band 20–45 s; ports ECGDex detectCVHR)

timeseries.doc: 5-min epochs — primary cross-node feed (posture rides on epochs[].position).

ppi.doc: Per-beat PPI from the SELF-COMPUTED optical spine (3-LED consensus → buildPPI → Malik correctRR) — the device _PPI.txt is often header-only and its _HR.txt all-zero, so this is the ONLY interval series for this sensor, not a second opinion. `spine` names which fiducial won (foot or peak). tSec[i] is the beat time in seconds from startEpochMs; ms[i] is the interval ENDING at that beat. Beat times are EXPLICIT, never reconstructed by cumulative sum — a dropout would otherwise be closed silently and every later beat shifted.
